nom: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica Relief Ampoule

avis.titre: Perd3ct for my redness and acne prone skin.
avis.texte: I tend to get a lot of redness and break out often so I was looking for something to help. This product seems to be doing trick.

avis.titre: MUST BUY FOR ACNE PRONE SKIN
avis.texte: I destroyed my skin barrier a couple years ago with micro needling and THIS product has saved my skin! Its the first step in my skincare routine ALWAYS! I've noticed less breakouts and less redness.
It cleared up a few of my dark spots. This leaves my skin glossy.

I used the pink poremizing serum and really loved it. I was shocked at how good it was, so when i was having some hormonal breakouts I snagged this. I know this has a lot of postive reviews, but this serum is awful. It feels filmy, and heavier than the pink one. It doesnt absorb fully and my face feels mildly greasy/shiny. When I used it, I developed acne and redness. I stopped using it on my face for about a month. During that month I did use it a few times on chest breakouts (just to use it and not waste it) and I do think it helped calm some redness there. The other day I washed my face (A.M.) and was like, okay let me use this serum alone with nothing else on a clean face-and by the end of the day I had breakouts developing along my chin. And my chin was very red. Which confirmed this product, for me at least, causes irritation and acne. I would recommend 1000% the pink poremizing serum. But i would rip this green tea tree cica one from anyones hands saying spare yourself. Dont buy it.

This is a lightweight serum that absorbs fast. Great for me since I have sensitive skin especially when the weather is cold. It does a great job calming my skin. My skin felt balanced without any dryness. It felt gentle with effective relief.
I like the feel and my kin has been super dry this winter so it's been keeping it hydrated. It feels really nice on my skin.
Good quality product. Love it. My face looks so fresh and clean after using it

I recently learned my skin really likes Cica so I was happy to try this ampoule in exchange for my review. I can't say this product completely changed my skin but I did notice some improvements. The next day my skin looked a less irritated and more brightened. Also surprised the smell was not too strong as it usually does with tea tree products. Overall, I think its a good product but not great, maybe I just need to use it longer.

I have used plenty of other Skin1004 products over the years. This one doesn't do anything spectacular for me. The sunscreens are a holy grail, this just didn't really do much of anything. I gave it a solid month of use in accordance with the labeling and I can honestly say I will not purchase. I was gifted this product in exchange for my honest review.

The lightweight, fast-absorbing formula instantly soothes my skin and helps calm redness and irritation. It feels hydrating without being sticky, and I've noticed my skin looks healthier and more balanced with regular use. A gentle and effective ampoule for sensitive or reactive skin. Love it!!

I love this product, it works as advertised. It is light and refreshing. I love the soothing texture and the fact that there is no overwhelming smell. I use it as a first step in my skincare and it pairs with other products well!
This product is more watery than a serum. However, it is lightweight, does not feel heavy and absorbs in the skin quickly.

I used this every night during my typical skincare routine and notices that my pores shrunk and my acne cleared right up. Do not use on dry skin but stick to your skincare steps and incorporate accordingly. I do not use in the AM

received the tea-Tricia relief ampoule for free in exchange for a review. The consistency was great and so was the smell. I had really high hopes for the product. Unfortunately, it broke me out and really irritated my skin. I would not recommend for those with truly sensitive skin.
This product is really great to help combat breakouts and acne. I have very acne prone skin and the turnover time for healing was really shortened thanks to this product.

I received the tea-Tricia relief ampoule for free in exchange for a review. Thank you Skin1004! I really like this product so far. The consistency is very light weight and I don't mind the smell. I also like how the dropper helps place the product perfectly, how fast absorption is and how my skin feels instantly calm.The price point for such a large amount of product is such a steal! I will continue to use this and hopefully see good results!

avis.titre: Soothing and Moisturizing- Perfect Winter Skincare Product
avis.texte: I received this product via a BzzAgent campaign. I've been using the product daily for a little over a week now. I have seen a noticeable difference in my skin. Others have described my skin as "glowing." This product is lightweight, it smells good, has reduced the appearance of redness, and my breakouts have reduced. It's had a soothing effect on my skin. I will continue using this product. If you have acne prone, dry/combination skin, this product could possibly help with those.

I've been using this product and I'm genuinely impressed. The lightweight, non-sticky formula absorbs quickly and instantly soothes my sensitive, irritated skin. It feels very calming and helps reduce redness without clogging my pores, making it perfect for my blemish-prone skin. My complexion looks more balanced and comfortable, and it has truly become a staple in my skincare routine. I usually break out when I try new products, but that didn't happen at all with this one.

I love this serum. Its very watery in texture and a little goes a long way. It has a light tea tree scent but nothing powerful like pure tea tree oil. Also it does not sting at all! I've used it on active breakouts, healing break outs, scabs, eczema and it just calms inflamed skin. Im so glad to have this product in my routine.

avis.titre: Helps with dryness. Keeps skin moisturized.
avis.texte: Helps with dryness. Keeps skin moisturized. Will continue to use.

This is such a good ampoule! It is a water consistency, but thick enough so that it feels like it is creating an actual layer on your skin. It soaks in quickly and leaves your skin feeling super soft. I definitely need to keep using this to completely see the effects, but as of now, I'm really happy with the results. I definitely recommend!

writing this reveiw in exchange for a product from Bzzagent, i like how light and water like this product is, i have been able to use all of my other products on top of it to layer and it works well. the packaging is fuss free and a little goes a ong way

I love Skin1004 products, but the Centella Tea-Trica Relief Ampoule is one of my new favorites. My skin has been growing more sensitive with age, and I find the Centella really helps to calm that. I also have random bouts of acne (even at near 40!) and this helps to limit that. As with all other products I've tried from Skin1004, the scent is perfect. Calming but not too strong. Love!!

The Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica Relief Ampoule has become one of my absolute favorite skincare products. The serum feels amazing on my skin. It's so lightweight, soothing, and refreshing. Every time I use it, my skin feels instantly hydrated and calm, and I get that fresh, glowy look I'm always chasing. It's gentle enough for my sensitive skin and makes my skin both look and feel incredible. The bottle is gorgeous too. The sleek design and smooth dropper make it so easy to use and feel extra luxurious. I'm genuinely obsessed with this ampoule. It's definitely a 10/10 and a new must-have in my skincare routine!

avis.titre: Ideal for Sensitive Skin and Redness
avis.texte: I suffer from eczema and facial redness due to sensitive skin. I've recently heard about Centella Asiatica extract and how it is beneficial to people with acne-prone or sensitive skin like mine. Thankfully I was able to receive a free product from Skin1004 to try it out. The Tea-Trica Relief Ampoule by Skin1004 contains Centella Asiatica extract, Tea Tree water, and pine extract to help sooth reddened and sensitive skin. Please note that this product might not be for everyone as everyone's skin is different. Fortunately, this product works for me and I have not have not had any adverse reactions. I use it before applying my regular Vitamin C serum and moisturizer and have found that it amplifies Vitamin C absorption in helping to brighten skin while preventing some of the redness and sensitivity. The price point is reasonable and I'm a huge fan of Korean skincare that is backed by a mix of experience and science. The consistency is like a toner and the application is straightforward. I like that it comes in a dropper format which allows me to control how much I use. A little goes a long way, I find. The formula is light and watery and primes your skin for serum and moisturizer. I can see myself using this for a long time and highly recommend it to those who suffer from skin sensitives or redness.
I use this at night before my moisturizer. It soaks into the skin quickly and feels nice. Doesn't break me out and mixes well with my other products. Also doesn't irritate my skin.

Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica Relief Ampoule is lightweight, however it does leave a sticky residue. Its also easy to apply and absorbs quickly.It is great for daily gentle healing. I've only been using it for a few days now without any breakouts or irritation.

This is the first Skin1004 I've ever tried and I'm glad to have discovered them. This is also my first time using an ampoule. This has been great for my mild acne and cold weather redness. I have sensitive skin and was not irritated at all by the tea tree water. This is a great product to use if you have mild acne and deal with some redness.
At first i didn't know what to expect, but I've been incorporating this i to my daily skincare routine and my skin has been loving it! No new breakouts! Also really like the dropper.

I received this product for free from SKIN1004 through the BzzAgent sampling program. I have been using this everyday twice a day and I have loved the results so far. It has helped even out my skin and reduce redness. It doesn't leave my skin feeling greasy and absorbs into my skin quickly.

The Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica Relief Ampoule is a lightweight, calming serum that instantly soothes redness, irritation, and acne-prone skin without feeling heavy or sticky. It absorbs quickly, helps control excess oil, and uses Centella + tea tree to reduce inflammation and promote a clearer, more balanced complexion. Most people notice softer texture and calmer breakouts, though it may feel too light for very dry skin and a few users with sensitivity to botanical ingredients might experience mild reactions. Overall, it's a great daily ampoule for anyone wanting gentle healing, reduced redness, and a clean, refreshed glow
This product was amazing for my sensitive skin. I didnt have any reactions and my face felt so soft and smooth after a couple of uses!

I've been using this ampoule every day, and it has become one of my favorite skincare products. The texture is light, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave any stickiness. It helps minimize the appearance of pores, calms redness, and makes my skin look smoother and fresher. I love how gentle it is — perfect even for sensitive skin. There's nothing I dislike about it so far. It works exactly as described, and I'm very happy with the results.

This product has a lightweight texture and it has a subtle herbal scent to it. I cleansed my skin, applied a moisturizing toner and then used a couple drops of the Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica Relief Ampoule to my fingertips and patted it on my breakout areas, primarily around my jawline. I found this product to be gentle while also helping to clear up my breakouts. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest feedback.

I was a bit skeptical at first since I have used another brand's centella toner that didn't do much, but I've been using this every day for the past week and have noticed a huge difference in my skin! I have a very oily T-zone with lots of little bumps/texture, and the amouple has really improved my texture and the redness/discoloration from the acne. I also have quite a bit of dry skin around my jaw and mouth, and it has also helped hydrate the area while not being irritating. The ampoule itself is light and has a very subtle tea-tree oil scent, which smells so good. My skin is smoother and definitely more even now–super impressed with how quickly it started to work. Definitely will purchase after I run out.

I wasn't sure what to expect from this product, especially since it mostly seems to be water with some tea tree stuff and others. I feel my skin has been enjoying this, though. I'm pretty sensitive to a lot of products and I'm acne prone with rosacea, but I've had no issues with this product. No burning or clogged pores. I feel like it has actually been soothing some acne I had on my back and face (I have been using this stuff literally everywhere!). It's hydrating, especially if you layer some light moisturizer on top. Really, no complaints. I think it's a nice addition to my routine. I also really enjoy the glass bottle and dropper. When you take the dropper out, there's a little built in scrapper to make sure no product drips off the sides of the dropper, which is AMAZING! Brilliant! Every serum needs that!!!!!

avis.titre: Surprisingly good on my rosacea skin
avis.texte: I was nervous to try this because I have very sensitive, rosacea skin that has been worse than usual the last few months. I was getting pretty bad flare ups on my t-zone and cheeks with a ton of redness and bumps. I started using this and the flare up started calming down a little more each day. I still have some bumps but compared to what it was it's 85% healed and the redness has gone from tomato to a light pink. I use 6 drops and only use it at night after I take my makeup off and skip applying 2-3 days a week. I don't think it's sticky at all and just feels like I'm putting a little water all over my face. I'm really surprised it hasn't made my rosacea worse because everything else seems to. The smell is also pretty minimal and I don't mind it. I'm not sure if it would be too much if I applied it twice a day and/or used it every single day but as of now I'm happy with the product and don't plan on increasing how often I use it.

I have dry and sensitive skin, and since I don't struggle with a lot of acne, this isn't the most targeted product for my skin type. However, I still enjoy using it because it really soothes my skin. It calms any redness or irritation almost instantly and feels very gentle. The texture is watery and lightweight, so it absorbs fast without leaving any sticky feeling. It also has no strong scent, which is perfect for sensitive skin. Even though it's designed more for oily or acne-prone skin, I love how hydrating and calming it feels on my dry skin.

Actually I used this serum after shower. I have very sensitive skin and dry skin and this serum was game changer to my skincare routine. I put 2 or 3 layers and my skin redness disappears after few minutes. It's a huge bottle and it will last forever.

avis.titre: Calming, gentle, and already seeing a glow!
avis.texte: I received this product for free from SKIN1004 through the BzzAgent sampling program, and I've been really impressed so far. This product has such a calming effect on my skin, it feels soothing from the very first application. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without any stickiness. After using it consistently, I'm starting to notice a more even, glowing complexion, and some of my irritation and redness have visibly improved. My skin just feels more balanced and healthy overall. If you're looking for something gentle that helps calm the skin while also boosting radiance, this ampoule is definitely worth trying. I'm excited to keep using it and see the longer-term results!
I like the way this product left my skin. No breakouts. My face wasn't oily but hydrated and looked healthy
I have tried a lot serums and this is the only one that truly works for me
Very gentle on the skin gives you a nice glow too and I think it's really good for the price too! This item was gifted to me
I love this product! It's easy to use and feels nice on the skin. It doesn't feel sticky and absorbs into the skin quickly! I've noticed my skin looking a lot better after using this product!

I received this product for my honest review, I have been using this product for the last 15 days and it has helped with the excess sebum I have on my nose and chin. It leaves my face hydrated and soft. I have mild rosacea and it has even helped clear that up. I had high hopes for this product and it exceeded my expectations! I highly recommend this to anyone that has any rough patches, oily skin or even for someone that just wants an extra boost of hydration! 10/10 would recommend! I am excited to try the other skin1004 ampoules!!

I get minor irritated spots from time to time, and this Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica Relief Ampoule has been such a lifesaver. The moment I put it on, my skin feels calmer and soothed. It's so easy to use, sinks in instantly, and the light, comforting scent makes the whole routine feel nicer!
I love the light tea scent it leaves on my skin after applying it. My skin looks smoother and more glowing and firm after I put it on.

avis.titre: I would definitely recommend buying this product
avis.texte: The product is super lightweight. Feels very gentle on the skin and is very effective.

avis.titre: One of my tried and true
avis.texte: I have been using this ampoule for over 5 years and it has done wonders to my skin. Hydrates without causing a breakout and soothed any irritation especially during the winter months. I have sensitive and acne prone skin so this was perfect for me.

It is slighrly expensive but it actually has really helped with minimizing my pores and calming down inflammation from my hormonal acne during my periods! It even gave my skin a nice healthy glow without looking over radiant or oily (my natural skin type). It also has a nice scent without irritation. I've used it both everyday as a toner and now use it two to three times a week as an acne treatment and both have provided great results. I would buy again!

With age 40s type ii rosacea-prone skin, I pair this with azalaic acid to soothe redness and prevent the little bumps and breakouts. It seems to layer well with the AA though the combo can be drying and I moisturize thoroughly as my last step. Even with the rosacea my skin looks better than it ever has. I'm using 2x daily and am slowly working through the bottle, so it's a good amount of toner for the price. Will repurchase.
It may be other factors but after I started using this to calm inflammation, it made my skin extremely sensitive and started breaking me out, I would say use it with precaution

I'm 31, and have struggled with cystic hormonal acne for over a decade. finally, after 9 years of the same skincare routine, I decided to finally try out new products in hopes I'd get better results. I've been using this product for about 4 days (in combination with a new face wash for 1 day) and my skin is completely clear. when I first started using this, I thought there was no way it'd do anything. it has no smell, and is the consistency of water. it's lightweight and feels like nothing on the skin. I definitely don't think my results are from the new face wash as I've only used it once, and plan to re-purchase this when I run out!
Was having issues with acne & this helped clear my skin without drying it out. Highly recommend!

I was a bit worried that this serum wouldn't do anything because it doesn't have actives, but it's really helped with my texture, redness, and it doesn't break me out. It also feels really cooling which is nice and I can use it with literally anything else because it has no actives to irritate my skin. Really good, prob will repurchase🙏🫶
Instantly calms my rosacea, helps cystic zits de-puff, my skin has never been happier. And as a girlie who can't tolerate niacinamide, theres none in this product! so its an even bigger win!!

This serum is hands-down the best thing I've ever used for acne, bumps. Within just a few days, I noticed the inflammation going down. It's lightweight, non-greasy, and doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. This is my four bottle!!

This serum is hands-down the best thing I've ever used for acne, bumps. Within just a few days, I noticed the inflammation going down. It's lightweight, non-greasy, and doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. This is my four bottle!!

My skin is so acne prone. 95% of products cause me to break out but this stuff sooths my face and locks in moisture! I just repurchased my 3rd bottle. People say this is a wesk version if the yellow ampuole but i do not agree.

I am absolutely in love with this product. I have hormonal chin acne that I have been using spirnolactone for which helps, but this product has completely changed it for me. It made all those tiny white bumps disapear and my red flaky skin also has completely disappeared. I have very sensitive skin and this is amazing!

I am absolutely in love with this product. I have hormonal chin acne that I have been using spirnolactone for which helps, but this product has completely changed it for me. It made all those tiny white bumps disapear and my red flaky skin also has completely disappeared. I have very sensitive skin and this is amazing!

Ive been struggling with acne around my chin for a while. No matter what I used I still had a few breakouts it was never all clear. Started using this and it was like day and night. My breakouts seemed to calm down and it did wonders for the inflammation in the area. Its alot of product and I love how fast absorbing non oily it feels. It has become one of my holy grails for sure ;)
I've been struggling with breakouts for a long time and no matter what I used nothing would help I used this product once a day for a week and I already started seeing results!

very good for acne and/or sensitive skin. highly recommend! I could feel my skin being less irritated after the first use. this is the product that turned me into a skin1004 fan. I'm also trying their cleanser which is so soft and soothing.
I have acne prone skin, and sensitive skin this does wonders bought this a week ago and noticed it within a week. My skin was looking smooth, and my acne was fading. Highly recommended!

This is a great product at a reasonable price. The full size bottle available for purchase in the US is huge; there are travel size ones available from K Beauty stores if you want to try a lower volume first. I use this almost every single day, either after morning toning, or evening cleansing, or both. This helps keep my skin calm post shower, and before I use therapeutic heat for TMJ. Unlike a lot of other tea tree K Beauty, there's not much scent, which is for the best imo. If you're sensitive combo, or battling intermittent redness that's not rosacea, give this a couple of weeks.

avis.titre: I would buy this again and again
avis.texte: I have the worst seborrheic dermititis around my mouth and this literally calms it down right away. It's perfect to calm down my skin before makeup! I love it so much.

This worked kver night on my skin . I recently tried a new oil cleanser from another brand it broke me out ! Real bad. I went and purchased this ampoule and the next day saw decrease size in my pimples and redness. My skin felt calm !
